description: feature fixture on Two Continents: a dense forest of Tree1/Tree3 (def height 40, the tall class), with ARM units parked two 16-px tile rows NORTH of a tree row so each canopy overlaps the unit standing behind it — the occlusion proof for the native feature pass with the G12a scaffold disarmed. A commander stands among the trees as a large, easily-read occlusion subject, a laboratory wreck exercises the 3D-wreckage body of 0x46A610 (native.on must carry "wrecks"), and a CORE spare keeps the game alive. NOTE: a scenario `move` order across this forest does not go where it is told — every attempt walked the commander to the map's west edge instead of the target (the order is accepted, "orders: 1 issued, 0 failed"); undiagnosed, so this fixture does not depend on it.
